title: Calculate Factorial
description: Read a non-negative integer `n` (`0 <= n <= 20`) and print `n!` (the factorial of `n`). Remember `0! = 1`.
instructions: Multiply `fact` by each integer from `2` to `n`.
hints: In Java, `20!` fits in a `long` (`2432902008176640000`), not an `int`.
When `n = 0`, the loop from `2` to `0` does not run, so `fact` stays `1`.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
# Compute and print n!
